text:
sasha: Heads-up — planning an overnight rolling maintenance for EU-edge pool (eu-edge-3/4) tomorrow 00:30-04:30 UTC. We'll do staggered node drains + controlled reboots to apply NIC microcode and fan calibrations. Expect transient KV-cache cold starts for bursty tenants.

kai: ack. which pools exactly? how large will each cohort be?

sasha: splitting into 6 cohorts ~8 nodes each. Drain + reboot per cohort ~20-25m, with 10m warmup (kv cache seed) after. Total window 4h to allow retries.

maria: any high-priority tenants that need to be excluded from this? we should check dedicated reservations.

sasha: good point — we'll exclude Dedicated-provisioned pools and tenants tagged `priority:enterprise`. Only Hosted and interruptible cohorts get cycled.

dave: cost question — if we backfill with burst capacity in another region during warmup, will that hit billing hard?

sasha: yes, cross-region backfill -> egress and extra GPU-hours. Estimated ~2-3% cluster spend spike for the window. I'm proposing to prefer cold-cache tail latency over heavy cross-region backfill where possible to keep costs down.

jen: operational ask — can we enable canary fallback to quantized variants for model routes that are tolerant? that would lower token cost during the warmup spikes.

sasha: +1. ops will push routing policy to prefer `model-x-quant` in the eu-edge region when latency spikes >300ms, fallback to local full model once KV hits threshold.

product-ops: Heads-up for product — please prepare a short banner for customers in eu regions (scheduled maintenance, low probability of increased latency 00:30-05:00 UTC). We should avoid saying "downtime"; emphasize "rolling reboots with brief latency increases".

oncall-bot: [ALERT] Maintenance window scheduled by sasha: eu-edge-3/4 2027-11-07 00:30-04:30 UTC. Cohort details posted in #eng-infra.

maria: During each cohort, pls run `kvseed --pool eu-edge-3 --cohort 2 --parallel 16` after reboot to speed warmup — and tag traces with `maintenance-window=1779992024`.

sasha: will do. Also adding `egress-throttle=0.8` to limit noisy tenants' cross-region fallback.

dave: can we get an rough estimate of client impact (p50/p90/p99 shift)? ballpark numbers help product comms.

sasha: rough estimate: p50 ~ unchanged, p90 increases 30-80ms during warmup, p99 may see spikes up to 350ms for a few minutes if cache miss storms happen.

jen: I'll prepare an ops playbook snippet for oncall with runbook steps: rollback cohort, increase kvseed parallelism, flip routing, and customer comm template.

product-ops: thanks — please drop the comm draft here by EOD. We'll send a short email to affected eval tenants and a banner to hosted users.

sasha: committing runbook and kvseed script in the maintenance doc now. Ping me in-thread for last-minute exceptions. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: [REMINDER] 30m before window starts — please confirm readiness or cancel.
